title: Eric Weinstein joins Galileo Project, geometric unity UAP physics

tellings.quote: My colleague Eric Weinstein recently joined the Galileo project. We sometimes speculate about the physics of UAPs.

plain: The mathematician Eric Weinstein is said to have joined the Galileo Project, a Harvard-based effort to search the sky for UAP, or unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs. The line comes in Michels's 2022 episode with the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb, attributed to Michels: "My colleague Eric Weinstein recently joined the Galileo project. We sometimes speculate about the physics of UAPs." It matters because it would put a theoretical thinker to work on how such objects might move.
